summary: Checked only the four requested estimates. Read the complete main-paper markdown (380 lines) and supplement markdown (577 lines), including references, end matter and all supplementary sections. Read the extraction specification and codebook. Extracted every cited PDF page with PyMuPDF: main pp. 5-7 and supplement pp. 10-12; also checked main methods pp. 3-4 and supplement procedures pp. 13-14. Recovered both regression tables with find_tables() and inspected in-memory rendered crops of the main mathematical results, mediation figures and supplementary regression tables. All eight supplied mechanical warnings are false positives. The main PDF mathematical font extracts equals signs as U+00BC, decimals as colons and minus signs as U+0002; the script also fails to recognize flattened subscripts. Main p. 5 explicitly prints objective expert-rated creativity: human M=2.311, SD=0.469; LLM M=2.45, SD=0.453; t with df 202=−2.154, P=0.032, d=−0.301; 95% CI (−0.266, −0.012). These are objective outcomes despite the Self-reported creativity heading. The negative t and d retain the printed human-minus-LLM direction. The CI estimand and d standardizer are not specified, so the corresponding nulls are appropriate. Main p. 6 prints the S2 response-type main effect F with df (1,200)=0.811, P=0.369, partial eta squared=0.004. No signed pooled total effect or pooled arm descriptives are supplied. Supplement p. 12, Table S7, Model 4, prints Partner type coefficient −0.186 and SE 0.230; Table S8, Model 4, prints LLM response type coefficient 0.029 and SE 0.146. The quoted row labels and selected Model 4 cells are correct; intervening Model 1-3 cells explain the failed contiguous-text matches. Model 4 adjusts for creative fixation and inspirational stimulation, with blank task-complexity and interaction cells. These are direct adjusted effects, kept separate from the original total-effect tests. The note explicitly identifies bootstrap standard errors. Coefficient standardization, exact treatment p-values, treatment CIs and model-specific counts are not stated. The four problems concern only the two analyzed arm-count fields in each adjusted regression: the demographic counts are printed, but their applicability to those regression samples cannot be confirmed. Null is the supported replacement pending model-specific documentation. This does not establish that the recorded counts are numerically wrong. For the original pooled tests, Tables S5-S6 explicitly supply 104 treatment and 100 control participants, and main Fig. 2/Fig. 4 print N=204 for the creativity analyses. The checked question, construct, measure, participant unit, higher_is, AI availability, immediate timing, within_person, comparison_type, se_basis and preregistered_primary codes are appropriate. Creativity is expert-scored participant work produced with the partner ideas available, using between-participant assignment; S1 has an active human-partner comparator, and S2 tests constrained-responsive against batch-responsive LLM. No preregistration is stated. The supplement_changes log contains only the four null-to-count additions to the original estimates. Every retained main-text statistic agrees with the main PDF; no main-text numerical value was changed. Only the requested verification JSON was written.
